jobs.prompt:
Create ONE isolated physical inventory icon for Joseon Hunters, a Korean dark-fantasy ARPG with Diablo II Resurrected tangible painted-object readability. Use a Korean dark-fantasy painterly style, realistic waxy jade material, restrained saturation, directional broad physical highlights, visible thickness and a dark readable contour.
Refine ONLY the highest grade jade to look unmistakably more valuable and easier to recognize at 24 pixels. Grade 3 stays an oval cabochon. This grade 4 is a meticulously finished broad UPRIGHT OCTAGONAL PILLOW jade, about 0.88 as wide as tall, with four clearly chamfered corners, four long straight outer edges, one large softly domed central stone face and a broad polished beveled rim. The eight-sided OUTLINE must be obvious even as a tiny inventory icon and in grayscale. This is a solid traditional lapidary JADE stone with a softly domed face, NOT a diamond, a faceted modern crystal, a coin, ring, amulet or jewelry. Do not add triangular diamond cuts, a hole, metal setting, gold outline, wire, cords, inscriptions, runes or symbols. One single complete undamaged stone, no detached pieces. The finest controlled polish and clear rich stone depth, no cloudy inclusions obscuring the face. The actual stone occupies 78-84 percent of square height, all margins clearly empty and centered. Keep compact proportions and a shallow three-quarter angle with thickness visible along one side.
COLOR: Deep cinnabar-red jade with subtle dark red-brown mineral clouds, restrained warm ivory edge reflections.
Natural studio lighting only; no emissive glow, white aura, surrounding shadow, particles, sparks, lens flare or magical effects. Transparent background, no scenery, backdrop, text, labels, numbers, UI frame, people, hands or display stand. Return one 1024 square image.

contract.reason: same-sized grade 3/4 must differ in silhouette at actual inner 24 pixels
